projects.name: EmbodiedGen V2
projects.verified_scope: Agentic generation of simulation-ready articulated assets, layouts, affordances, tasks, and cross-simulator export paths.
projects.boundary: The public repository and paper were audited, but the generation stack was not executed in this workspace.

projects.name: RoboVerse / MetaSim
projects.resume_relation: Named unified simulation and data-generation project.
projects.verified_scope: Cross-simulator configuration, APIs, assets, data generation, and benchmarking through the MetaSim abstraction.
projects.boundary: RoboVerse is an integration and benchmark substrate, not by itself a language-to-scene generator, and was not run here.

projects.name: Scaling Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning for Robot VLAs with Generative 3D Worlds
projects.license: Paper only; implementation path is documented through EmbodiedGen.
projects.verified_scope: Uses generated interactive 3D worlds for reinforcement-learning fine-tuning and reports simulation and real-robot evaluation.
projects.boundary: This is evidence for the /train, /evaluate, and /transfer loop, not a separately released environment codebase.

projects.name: DIPO
projects.license: No repository LICENSE file located in the audited snapshot.
projects.verified_scope: Dual-state image input to articulated part layout, joint parameters, and URDF-oriented assets, with PM-X data construction.
projects.boundary: The repository documents external API and checkpoint dependencies; no generated asset was imported into RoboTwin or Isaac here.

projects.name: 3D-Fixer
projects.verified_scope: Single-image, layout-preserving reconstruction and completion of in-place 3D scene assets using fragmented geometry anchors.
projects.boundary: The output still needs metric-scale, collision, physics, and simulator-import gates before it is an executable environment.

projects.name: Uni3R
projects.verified_scope: Unposed multi-view images to Gaussian scene representation with open-vocabulary semantics and depth.
projects.boundary: The representation is an observation and semantic sidecar, not collision geometry, dynamics, or an executable task environment; release-status statements in the README are internally inconsistent.

projects.name: GaussTR
projects.verified_scope: Semantic occupancy prediction using Gaussian representations and foundation-model alignment on nuScenes.
projects.boundary: Useful for observation and data-loop context, but it does not generate executable simulator environments.
